This tutorial explains, from scratch, how to download and analyze **methane
(CH4)** from **Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI** over **Brazil**. Follow in order:

1. [Copernicus account](01-conta-copernicus.qmd) — create account and credentials
2. [API links](02-links-api.qmd) — find the endpoints
3. [Daily series](03-diaria.qmd) — `P1D`
4. [Monthly series](04-mensal.qmd) — `P1M`
5. [Annual series](05-anual.qmd) — derived from monthly
6. [Maps with raw L2](06-mapas-l2.qmd) — GeoTIFF ~1 km
7. [Maps with Google Earth Engine](07-mapas-gee.qmd)
8. [Security](08-seguranca.qmd) — protect your credentials
9. [Citation and license](09-citacao.qmd)

## Requirements

- Python 3.10 or newer;
- a free [Copernicus Data Space](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu) account;
- (optional, for GEE maps) a Google account with Earth Engine access.

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env
```

> The `.env` file stores your credentials and must **never** be committed.
